from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

root = Path('products/services/welfare-tender')
matches = []
for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if path.is_file() and any(term in str(path.relative_to(root)).lower() for term in ('operator', 'case-card', 'eligible-case', 'lot-source', 'verdict')):
        data = path.read_bytes()
        matches.append({'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps({'scope': str(root), 'matching_public_artifacts': matches}))
